---
title: "Statistics"
description: "Probability, inference, and models for biological variation."
---

Statistics notes are organized into six topic maps. The sidebar stays compact by
linking to these maps rather than listing every individual note.

## Probability & Randomness

[Probability & Randomness](probability-randomness/index.qmd) covers probability
foundations, random variables, distributions, dependence, and moments.

## Asymptotic Thinking

[Asymptotic Thinking](asymptotic-thinking/index.qmd) connects convergence, laws
of large numbers, central limit theory, and large-sample approximations.

## Statistical Inference

[Statistical Inference](statistical-inference/index.qmd) organizes estimation,
uncertainty, hypothesis testing, resampling, power, and multiplicity.

## Regression & Statistical Models

[Regression & Statistical Models](regression-models/index.qmd) develops linear
and generalized models, diagnostics, interpretation, and model comparison.

## Advanced Modeling

[Advanced Modeling](advanced-modeling/index.qmd) collects regularization,
hierarchical models, mixtures, survival analysis, and multivariate methods.

## Real Bioinformatics Problems

[Real Bioinformatics Problems](bioinformatics-problems/index.qmd) applies
statistical reasoning to experimental design and high-throughput biological data.
